purpose: Canonical retrieval contract for the 12 textured Celine v80 room source GLBs.
important_path_semantics: library_root is a ChatGPT persistent Library path, not a repository path and not an automatically mounted worker filesystem path.
A worker must use an authorized Files/Library retrieval or materialization capability before programmatic 3D processing.
Never call ordinary filesystem open() on library_root unless the files have first been materialized into the worker workspace and the materialization result provides a real local path.
pre_assembly_gate: Read root AGENTS.md, live queue, active work order/amendment, validation policy, room README, execution trunk and this retrieval contract.
Retrieve/materialize the current Library files only when 4R room assembly/optimization actually begins.
Verify exactly 12 unique GLB filenames are present.
Verify every GLB SHA-256 against expected_sources and SOURCE_SHA256SUMS.txt before modifying or optimizing any source.
Preserve the Library originals unchanged; work only on materialized/workspace copies.
Nachttisch.glb may be instantiated twice in the final room but must remain one source binary.
Do not retrieve, restore or substitute the superseded six untextured GLBs.
hard_stop_conditions: Worker has GitHub access but no authorized Files/Library access or materialization capability.
Any of the 12 expected files is missing.
Any filename is unexpected or ambiguous.
Any SHA-256 differs from the canonical value.
The worker can see only stale/untextured room sources.
A tool tries to interpret library_root as a normal repository/local filesystem directory.
hard_stop_action: Do not build a substitute room, do not use stale GLBs, do not guess paths and do not continue 4R asset assembly. Record the source-access mismatch as the current blocker and request/perform authorized materialization first.
runtime_rule: Raw source GLBs are preservation inputs, not APK-ready assets. Optimize materialized copies and build the bounded modular production room; never copy all raw 120-189 MB GLBs directly into the APK.
viewer_rule: Tischfürlaptop.glb is the physical foreground table. The laptop itself is the camera/viewer and must not be visible in the final room.
